title: Every Model Leaves a Trace: Multi-Resolution LLM Fingerprinting
abstract: arXiv:2610.28434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models leave model-specific traces in their generated text, but it remains unclear how finely these fingerprints can distinguish related models and which signals remain informative as obvious cues are reduced. We study this through fingerprint resolution, considering both model resolution, from different families to distilled and adapted variants, and signal resolution across behavioral, stylometric, lexical, and semantic evidence. We progressively suppress surface cues, paraphrase outputs, vary the amount of available text, and test generalization across prompt distributions and languages. Our results show that fingerprints persist beyond broad family differences, remaining detectable in distilled models and even LoRA adaptations of the same base model. translated_title: 每个模型都会留下痕迹：多分辨率大语言模型指纹识别
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在其生成的文本中会留下模型特有的痕迹，但这些指纹能够以多精细的粒度区分相关模型，以及随着明显线索的减少哪些信号仍然具有信息量，目前尚不清楚。我们通过指纹分辨率来研究这一问题，既考虑模型分辨率（从不同模型家族到蒸馏和适配的变体），也考虑信号分辨率（涵盖行为、文体、词汇和语义层面的证据）。我们逐步抑制表层线索、对输出进行改写、改变可用文本的数量，并测试在提示分布和语言之间的泛化能力。我们的结果表明，指纹超越广泛的家族差异而持续存在，在蒸馏模型中仍可检测到，甚至在同一基础模型的LoRA适配版本中也可检测到。尽管随着表层和词汇线索被改变，归因能力会有所减弱，但仍然存在大量模型特有的信号。这些信号可以在不同的提示来源和语言之间迁移。
tldr: 该论文提出多分辨率大语言模型指纹识别框架，证明即使表层线索被抑制，LLM指纹在蒸馏模型乃至同一基座的LoRA适配模型中依然可检测，并能跨提示分布和语言迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-resolution LLM fingerprinting framework, showing that model fingerprints persist even in distilled and LoRA-adapted models and transfer across prompt distributions and languages, even as surface cues are suppressed.
